tool.name: nf-core dysgu
tool.description: Dysgu calls structural variants (SVs) from mapped sequencing reads. It is designed for accurate and efficient detection of structural variations.
tool.command:
<![CDATA[ dysgu run \\ -p ${task.cpus} \\ -x \\ $fasta \\ . \\ $input \\ | bgzip ${args2} --threads ${task.cpus} --stdout > ${prefix}.vcf.gz tabix ${args3} ${prefix}.vcf.gz
cat <<-END_VERSIONS > versions.yml "${task.process}": dysgu: \$(dysgu --version 2>&1) END_VERSIONS ]]>
